reply.text: This is an injury-adjacent symptom ("hamstring's tight"), so it's a medical_stop: I don't assess it or suggest how to train around it myself. I can't tell you whether a tight hamstring needs a doctor or physio, and I won't guess. Please have it looked at by a doctor or physio, not a coach. Until they clear you, I'll keep the training side on whatever they say, and I can keep sprints off your plan for this week if you want to set that as the rule.
